title: IG AST
summary: The IG Publisher's abstract syntax tree of a FHIR Implementation Guide (its resources, their dependency edges and the build plan), ingested into the folio that uses the IG. One branch per IG package id; the IG's own source need not be materialised.

avatar.reads: a tree from one root to three leaves — an IG's syntax tree, ingested into the folio

rationale: INGESTED into the folio that uses the IG (bean lehh). Owner, 2026-10-04: an IG's semi-static KG may stay remote, but its AST is still ingested into the folio, and a remote AST may also be materialised onto a local branch. So the CONSUMING instance declares the directory, on `storage.keyedBy: "family"` over `cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/<package id>`. `derived`: the IG Publisher computes it from the IG's source and it is regenerated, never edited.
